title: Epigenetic downregulation of hsa-miR-193b-3p increases Cyclin D1 expression level and cell proliferation in human meningiomas

publications.title: Epigenetic Downregulation of Hsa-miR-193b-3p Increases Cyclin D1 Expression Level and Cell Proliferation in Human Meningiomas.

institution: Maria Sklodowska-Curie National Research Institute of Oncology
needs_manual_review_reason: Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables. FACT-CHECK (2026-07-10): date_deposited and date_updated were both 'Not reported' despite the GEO record stating them explicitly (Series_submission_date, Series_last_update_date); filled in from the live source. PER-SAMPLE EXTRACTION AND CORRESPONDING-AUTHOR CORRECTION (2026-07-12): fetched all 27 individual GSM records directly. (1) corresponding_author changed from 'Paulina,,Kober, Beata,J,Mossakowska' (the paper's co-first, equal-contribution authors) to 'Mateusz,,Bujko'; the PMC full text (PMID 37686289, PMC10487813) author-notes name a single corresponding author, Mateusz Bujko (mateusz.bujko@pib-nio.pl), who is present in the live GEO Series_contributor list. (2) grade_breakdown filled from the per-GSM 'grade' characteristic: 9 grade 1, 8 grade 2, 5 grade 3 (22 meningiomas); grade_comparable tag set true. (3) tissue_preservation changed from 'Not reported' to 'ffpe'; all 27 GSM extract protocols state 'DNA was isolated from FFPE tissue'. (4) normal_control_tissue set to included=true, type 'leptomeninges', count 5; the cohort is 22 meningiomas plus 5 leptomeninges samples (histology: leptomeninges) used as normal reference. Sex and age are not present in the GSM characteristics, so they remain 'Not reported'. MOLECULAR SUBTYPE ADDED (2026-07-16): re-fetched all 27 GSM records via scripts/extract_gsm_characteristics.py's per-sample fallback (this series' family.soft.gz is 193.9MB) and found a per-sample 'nf2 mutant status' characteristic not previously captured (15 wildtype '0', 2 LOH '0/LOH', 5 mutant '1' -- 22, matching the 22 meningioma samples exactly, distinct from the 5 leptomeninges controls). This is a named driver-mutation-status field per docs/schema.md's own molecular_subtype_annotated example ('NF2/TRAF7/AKT1 driver groups'); molecular_subtype_annotated corrected from 'Not reported' to true, tags.molecular_subtype_annotated false to true. Re-verified grade (9/8/5), tissue_preservation (ffpe), and normal_control_tissue (leptomeninges, n=5) against the same fetch; unchanged. AUTHOR-LIST TRUNCATION FIX (2026-07-14): re-fetched the full author list directly from PubMed, the article's Oxford/PMC full text, and PMC10487813 (all three consistent) -- the record's publications[0].authors had been truncated to the first 6 of 10 true authors (missing Matyja E, Oziębło A, Mandat T, and Bujko M, the corresponding author who was already correctly captured in the separate top-level corresponding_author field). Author list corrected to the full 10: Kober P, Mossakowska BJ, Rusetska N, Baluszek S, Grecka E, Konopiński R, Matyja E, Oziębło A, Mandat T, Bujko M. corresponding_author ('Mateusz Bujko') re-confirmed correct via the PMC full-text author-notes asterisk/email marker (mateusz.bujko@pib-nio.pl); no change needed there.
